title: Builder branches and ownership
summary: Two isolated builder branches and a private file-ownership contract were published from the current main baseline.
evidence: The retrieval branch is assigned to Jarvis.
The access and scale branch is assigned to Wonder Woman.
The ownership contract prohibits cross-lane edits, production access, direct builder pushes to main, and self-verification.
Every merge requires tests, a sanitized receipt, assigned verification, orchestration review, and a pull request.
limitations: Repository-plan limits prevent mechanical branch protection. Pull-request-only merging is enforced operationally by Iron Man.
